topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I learned that my child would have the same teacher I once did, a warm sense of continuity enveloped me. I recalled the lessons, the assignments, the way this educator could bring the most vivid stories to life, igniting a passion for learning that has stayed with me all these years. I remember the way they inspired us to think critically and creatively, to reach beyond what we thought was possible. Now, imagining my child experiencing that same spark, being guided by hands as skilled and caring—I can't help but feel a deep-seated assurance that my child is in the best possible care.
